results.title: Docs question about the action contract

transcript.user: What happens if Hyperion sends delete_file with only a file name?
transcript.steward: If Hyperion sends a `delete_file` action with only a file name, the IDE validator will consider it ambiguous, as there could be multiple files with the same name. The IDE will return status "ambiguous". In such a case, the agent will ask the user which file they intend to delete.
